QuestInfo.name: The Path of a Pirate
QuestInfo.0: What does it mean to be a Pirate? Talk to #p1002101# in Lith Harbor.
QuestInfo.1: #p1002101# in Lith Harbor says you can choose to become a #bPirate#k once you reach #bLevel 10#k. He tells you to see #r#p1090000##k in #rThe Nautilus#k. If you'd like to walk there, check your World Map. (#rW#k)
QuestInfo.2: You learned what it takes to be a true Pirate from #p1090000#. You have a feeling this is the right path for you.

0.0: 오~ 해적이 되고 싶단건가? 마음의 준비는 단단히 했겠지?

yes.0: 좋아. #r해적#k은 #b힘(Str)#k과 민첩(Dex)함이 필요한 직업이라고 알고 있어. 해적이 되고 싶다면 #r노틸러스호#k의 #b#p1090000##k님을 만나러 가봐.

no.0: 해적이 되고 싶었던 거 아니었나? 뭐..어떤 직업이든 마음의 준비가 된다면 다시 나를 찾아와.

0.0: Oh, so you want to become a Pirate? Are you ready for it?

yes.0: Okay, being a #rPirate#k requires a delicate balance of #bStrength and Dexterity#k. If you want to become one, you may want to see #b#p1090000##k at #rThe Nautilus#k.

no.0: You're not here to become a Pirate? Well... whatever it is, if you feel like you're ready, let me know.

1.0: Did you come all the way here to become a Pirate?

yes.0: Not everyone can become a Pirate. In order to become one, you must be at least at Level 10.

npc.0: #b#p1090000##k has recently parked her ship The Nautilus in between Henesys and Ellinia, and is staying there.
